title: [review] tx_queue.py:405: pop() does not signal res
description: When pop() removes an entry that has a TxReservation attached (from push with return_reservation=True), the reservation is never signaled. Any caller awaiting the reservation via wait() will hang indefinitely. The entry object is discarded without calling reservation.set_result().
close_reason: Fixed: pop() now signals reservation.set_result(True) before returning data
